palette: #1a2340 deep navy — night sky, dark streets, shadows
#3b5fd9 royal blue — hero character hoodie, house siding, court
#d9d9d9 warm gray — roads, sidewalks, building walls
#e8b83a golden yellow — streetlight glow, court circle, banner, scoreboard numbers
#e8734a coral/orange — character shirt, orange court mat, car accents
#f2ead9 cream — lit windows, character skin, daylight sky
color_arc: Starts deep night (navy sky, moon, tiny warm window lights) → brightens to full cheerful daytime pastel (cream sky, saturated court, yellow banner) mid-sheet → sinks back into night by the last frames, ending on a purple-lavender interior lit by a bubble. Narrative rhythm: night → day → night, cool bookending a warm core.
caption_style: Bold rounded sans-serif (Nunito/Baloo-like), white fill with soft dark drop shadow, lowercase single words ('a', 'they', 'dancing', 'party', 'up', 'walked', 'goes', 'only') or short shouts ('HUSS!'), sized ~5–7% of frame height, placed low-center or center-bottom, one word per frame — implies a word-per-beat karaoke rhythm, popping in sync with narration.
character_staging: Mix of scale: extreme close-up on hero (frame 3, head/shoulders fills frame), medium hero shots (frames 4, 7, 8), and wide establishing shots with 3–8 tiny characters as color-dot partygoers (frames 1, 2, 6, 11). Characters are chunky silhouette-first shapes — cylinder limbs, blocky torsos, dot eyes, cone party hats in green/yellow/red — readable at any size. Facing: mostly toward or away from camera walking into the scene; hero faces camera in close-ups.
camera: Static wide establishing shots alternating with slow push-ins toward the hero; subtle high-angle-to-low-angle descend on the town pan (frames 1→2 feel like a drone tilt-down); courtroom scenes hold still; final frames drift laterally past houses (dolly-by). No whip pans — everything slow and floaty.
lighting: Night scenes: small warm point sources — glowing spherical streetlamps, golden window rectangles, one big white moon — high local contrast, deep navy ambient. Day scenes: flat soft ambient, almost shadowless, pastel brightness. Emissive objects (sun orb lamp frame 4, bubble frame 12) get soft radial glow bloom.
huss_treatment: 'HUSS!' appears 3 times, identical treatment each time: same bold white rounded font with dark drop shadow as all captions, same ~5–6% frame height, low-center placement — deliberately NOT enlarged or distorted; the repetition (frames 5, 7, 10) in flat identical styling is the joke, a deadpan chant against escalating scene changes.
empty_vs_dense: Very empty: 60–80% of every frame is flat sky, road, lawn, or court color. Detail is clustered in one focal zone per frame (a house, a scoreboard, a banner) with generous negative space — toy-town minimalism, never cluttered.
the_5_things: 1. Word-per-frame karaoke captions: one lowercase white bold rounded word per shot, low-center, constant size — never styled up, even for chant beats like HUSS!.
2. Day/night sandwich: open dark-blue night, punch to saturated pastel day for the party middle, return to night for the quiet ending — color carries the story arc.
3. Toy-scale staging alternation: wide drone shots where characters are tiny color dots, cut to a single hero filling the frame — maximum scale contrast, one focal subject per frame.
4. Punctum lighting: small glowing orbs and warm window rectangles floating in large flat navy negative space; light sources are simple geometric shapes with soft bloom.
5. Recurring landmark grammar: same basketball court, yellow banner, and party-hat crew reappear from new angles so the town feels continuous — reuse 2–3 set pieces, re-stage them.
